citations.quote: Ideally, he would like to treat aggregate demand as if it were generated by a "representative consumer" and use the changes in this fictional individual's welfare as a measure of aggregate welfare.
One special case in which this property holds arises when all consumers have identical preferences that are homothetic.
The wealth effect is one reason that the aggregate demand curve is downward sloping.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: MWG Ch.4 characterization of when individual demand aggregates cleanly into a representative-consumer demand: Gorman polar form with common b(p), identical homothetic preferences, or quasilinear preferences. Underlies macro AS-AD representative-agent shortcut.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Aggregate Demand and the Representative Consumer
